name: ClarityAI
tagline: Speech-to-speech tool that simplifies what someone says and speaks it back clearly at your level.
problem: Fast, technical speech excludes ESL speakers, neurodivergent listeners and people with auditory processing difficulties.
solution: Streams microphone audio for live transcription, rewrites the transcript to a chosen reading level or style, and speaks it back with a selectable voice and speed.
demo_moment: Team-described: speak a dense sentence and hear a simpler version seconds later.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 77 submissions.
Helps without forcing the listener to interrupt or ask for repeats.

lessons: A single, clear before-and-after makes an accessibility tool land.
